children: Overview
UK textile rental provider's H1 2026 revenue rose 0.2% yr/yr amid mixed segment performance
Adjusted operating profit and margin improved, reflecting operational efficiencies and disciplined cost management
Company progressing with £55 mln share buyback, about 51% completed by August 2026
Outlook
Johnson Service expects full-year 2026 adjusted operating margin of at least 14%
Company anticipates softer trading in HORECA to persist for the remainder of 2026
Workwear is expected to benefit from stable volumes and customer price increases
Result Drivers
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY - Co said margin improvement reflected focus on operational efficiencies and disciplined cost management
SEGMENT TRENDS - Workwear revenue rose on stable volumes and price increases; HORECA revenue fell amid suppressed volumes and higher churn
LOWER ENERGY COSTS - Energy costs as a percentage of revenue declined, supported by hedging and fixed contracts
